purpose: Own separator formatting (U+2502), whitespace markers (↵ per newline, · per 2+ space run), and boundary-source resolution (stream/computed/pending/unavailable) for the showTokens transcript display mode. Wires a showTokens sidebar preference and switch, and a token-view render branch, into chat-workspace.tsx without duplicating the formatting/resolution logic there (AC-STRUCT-3).

public_api.name: SEPARATOR
public_api.description: The single token-boundary glyph, U+2502 (BOX DRAWINGS LIGHT VERTICAL). Never ASCII '|'.

public_api.name: NEWLINE_MARKER
public_api.description: U+21B5 (DOWNWARDS ARROW WITH CORNER LEFTWARDS), inserted immediately before every literal '\n' in content.

public_api.name: SPACE_RUN_MARKER
public_api.description: U+00B7 (MIDDLE DOT), substituted 1:1 for each space character that is part of a run of 2+ consecutive spaces in content.

public_api.name: BoundarySource
public_api.description: Exactly one of four boundary-source states for a step (public-contract-boundary-source in ownership-ledger.json).

public_api.name: TokenBoundaryResult
public_api.signature: interface TokenBoundaryResult { source: BoundarySource; tokens: string[]; reason?: string }
public_api.description: Result shape returned by useTokenBoundaries / resolveBoundarySource. tokens is [] for pending/unavailable. reason is set only for unavailable.

public_api.name: resolveBoundarySource
public_api.signature: resolveBoundarySource(step: ConversationStep, computedState?: { status: "pending" | "resolved" | "error"; tokens?: string[] }): TokenBoundaryResult
public_api.description: Pure resolution function: stream wins whenever step.contentTokens is defined (read live off the array, not cached, per invariant-delta-step-identity); otherwise defers to the supplied computedState, defaulting to unavailable when none is supplied. No re-tokenization fallback (AC-ERR-1).

public_api.name: useTokenBoundaries
public_api.signature: useTokenBoundaries(step: ConversationStep, options?: { computedSource?: (step: ConversationStep) => Promise<string[]> }): TokenBoundaryResult
public_api.description: Hook shell. Stream branch is resolved directly and synchronously off step.contentTokens on every render (no id-keyed cache, so a growing contentTokens array under a stable step id is reflected immediately). When no contentTokens and no computedSource is supplied (S2's default production wiring, pre-S3), resolves to unavailable. When a computedSource is supplied (S2's own tests via MOCK-02-001, and S3's eventual real wiring), tracks a pending/resolved/error cycle keyed by (step.id, step.content) so stale in-flight requests for since-changed content are ignored on resolution.

public_api.name: formatTokenViewText
public_api.signature: formatTokenViewText(content: string, tokens: string[] | null): string
public_api.description: Single-pass formatter producing one display string: inserts SEPARATOR at token-boundary offsets derived from tokens (skipped when tokens is null, i.e. unavailable/pending sources render unseparated), and unconditionally augments every '\n' with a preceding NEWLINE_MARKER and substitutes SPACE_RUN_MARKER for each space in a 2+ run — both independent of tokens/boundary source per AC-UX-4's unconditional phrasing. Requires tokens.join("") === content when tokens is non-null (caller contract; violated only by a producer bug upstream).

public_api.name: getBoundaryNotice
public_api.signature: getBoundaryNotice(result: TokenBoundaryResult): { label: string; detail: string } | null
public_api.description: Returns the visible label/caveat for stream ("stream boundaries" + merge caveat) and computed ("computed boundaries" + standalone-tokenization caveat) sources, a named reason for unavailable, and null for pending (AC-ERR-1's no-flash requirement).

owned_data: None persisted. showTokens is a SidebarState field owned by chat persistence (src/lib/chat.ts), read by this module's consumer (chat-workspace.tsx), not owned by token-view itself.
